label: Where this deployment keeps things
description: What this tree asks of the place it keeps its own memory, apart from what @auth asks of it through state.port.json: that it be made ready before anything is served. A startup step fires it, under the profile whose memory needs preparing.

prepare.description: Make the guard's memory ready to answer, once, before the port opens: create the collections auth.store.json declares, and leave alone any that are there.
